- AtlasPay prefers portal ingestion, but their AP still expects an emailed PDF copy for manual systems during cutover.
- Remit/Legal name is "AtlasPay Inc." (per PO). VAT not present on PO; they operate in US but may have EU entities later.

Proposed reply to Maria: offer (A) as default (Redwood issues invoices, portal primary, emailed PDF copy to accounts.payable@atlaspay.com) and ask for PO number confirmation, VAT/Tax ID if applicable, and preferred remit name. Also propose sending the portal invite this week.
